title: Chronic Drug Delivery in Mice Using Osmotic Pumps
author: Jason Kim
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xuefnte

steps.title: Anesthetize mice
steps.instruction: Anesthetize mice via intraperitoneal injection of ketamine and xylazine.

substeps.instruction: Administer ketamine at 100 mg/kg body weight
Administer xylazine at 10 mg/kg body weight

steps.title: Prepare incision site
steps.instruction: Shave the hair at the incision site on the back of the mouse.

steps.title: Perform surgical incision
steps.instruction: Make an incision of approximately 0.5 cm between the scapulae using a sterilized scalpel.

steps.title: Insert osmotic pump
steps.instruction: Subcutaneously insert an Alzet mouse osmotic pump containing either the drug or a placebo.

steps.title: Close incision
steps.instruction: Suture or close the incision site using sterilized staples.

steps.title: Provide post-operative care
steps.instruction: Administer ketoprofen to minimize pain and house the mice individually.
